senses.definition: adj. in acc. c. as adv. (Ges§ 118o) barefoot (appar. stripped as to walking; always c. הלך);—אֵילְכָה שׁוֹלָל וְעָרוֹם Mi 1:8 Qr I will go barefoot and naked (Kt שילל); מוֹלִיךְ יוֹעֲצִם שׁ׳ Jb 12:17, cf. v 19.
